WITH tsl_cte AS (
    SELECT 
        p.panemark AS panel_id,
        p.powratew AS power_rated_w,
        pe.measpoww AS measured_power_w,
        e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
        i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
        pe.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS cum_deg_pct
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        performance pe ON p.panemark = pe.solmodref
    JOIN 
        environment e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry
    JOIN 
        inverter i ON p.hubregistry = i.siteref
)
SELECT 
    panel_id,
    power_rated_w,
    measured_power_w,
    soiling_loss_pct,
    inverter_efficiency_pct,
    cum_deg_pct,
    (
        (power_rated_w * cum_deg_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * soiling_loss_pct / 100) + 
        (measured_power_w * (1 - inverter_efficiency_pct / 100))
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    tsl_cte;

parts.text:
Here is the SQL query to calculate the Total System Loss (TSL) per panel using Inverter Efficiency Loss (IEL):

```sql
WITH tsl_cte AS (
    SELECT
        p.panemark AS panel_id,
        p.powratew AS power_rated_w,
        pe.measpoww AS measured_power_w,
        e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
        CAST(i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS NUMERIC) AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
        CAST(pe.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS NUMERIC) AS cum_deg_pct
    FROM
        panel p
    JOIN
        performance pe ON p.panemark = pe.solmodref
    JOIN
        environment e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry
    JOIN
        inverter i ON p.hubregistry = i.siteref
)
SELECT
    panel_id,
    power_rated_w,
    measured_power_w,
    soiling_loss_pct,
    inverter_efficiency_pct,
    cum_deg_pct,
    (
        (power_rated_w * cum_deg_pct / 100) +
        (measured_power_w * soiling_loss_pct / 100) +
        (measured_power_w * (1 - inverter_efficiency_pct / 100))
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM
    tsl_cte;
```

This query calculates the TSL for each panel by considering the power rated in watts, measured power in watts, soiling loss percentage, inverter efficiency percentage, and cumulative degradation percentage. The TSL is computed using the formula:

TSL = (PowerRatedW × CumDegPct/100) + (MeasuredPowerW × SoilingLossPct/100) + IEL

where IEL is the Inverter Efficiency Loss, calculated as (MeasuredPowerW × (1 - InverterEfficiencyPct / 100)).

        pe.measpoww AS measured_power_w,
        e.soillosspct AS soiling_loss_pct,
        i.power_metrics->>'inverteffpct' AS inverter_efficiency_pct,
        pe.efficiency_profile->'degradation'->>'cumdegpct' AS cum_deg_pct
    FROM 
        panel p
    JOIN 
        performance pe ON p.panemark = pe.solmodref
    JOIN 
        environment e ON p.hubregistry = e.arearegistry
    JOIN 
        inverter i ON p.hubregistry = i.siteref
)
SELECT 
    panel_id,
    power_rated_w,
    measured_power_w,
    soiling_loss_pct,
    inverter_efficiency_pct,
    cum_deg_pct,
    (
        (power_rated_w * cum_deg_pct / 100) +

        (measured_power_w * (1 - inverter_efficiency_pct / 100))
    ) AS total_system_loss
FROM 
    tsl_cte;
